boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented UNF rituals and recurring campus traditions, from the Osprey gesture to commencement’s closing song.

cards.title: Make the Swoop
cards.subtitle: UNF school-spirit gesture
cards.notes: Learn the Osprey-themed spirit gesture at orientation or a campus event, then use it respectfully when joining UNF school-spirit moments.
cards.short_summary: A recognized UNF school-spirit gesture tied to the Osprey identity.
cards.evidence_claim: UNF identifies Ozzie the Osprey as an iconic part of its tradition and uses the mascot to represent school pride at campus and athletic events.
cards.access_notes: No specific location or schedule is listed; look for orientation and athletics programming.

cards.title: Spot Ozzie
cards.subtitle: UNF mascot tradition
cards.notes: Keep an eye out for Ozzie at campus and athletic events, where the official mascot is used to mark Osprey pride and energy.
cards.short_summary: UNF’s Osprey mascot is a central visible symbol of campus tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: UNF calls Ozzie the Osprey its mascot and an iconic part of UNF tradition, seen across campus and at athletic events.
cards.access_notes: Appearance varies by event; consult UNF Athletics or Student Life programming.

cards.title: Start at Flight School
cards.subtitle: Fall welcome for first-year and transfer students
cards.notes: If you are a new Osprey, attend this fall welcome event to meet peers and get an official introduction to UNF traditions.
cards.short_summary: A fall welcome program that introduces new students to UNF traditions.
cards.evidence_claim: UNF describes Flight School as a fall event for first-year and transfer students that introduces UNF traditions and Osprey identity.
cards.access_notes: Designed for first-year and transfer students; check Student Life for the current fall event details.

cards.title: Join Week of Welcome
cards.subtitle: Semester-opening UNF event series
cards.notes: Use the opening-week schedule to sample activities, games, music, food, and campus introductions as new and returning Ospreys arrive.
cards.short_summary: UNF’s recurring series that opens fall, spring, and summer semesters.
cards.evidence_claim: UNF says Week of Welcome occurs at the start of fall, spring, and summer semesters to welcome returning and new Ospreys.
cards.access_notes: Dates and individual activities vary each semester; consult Student Life’s event calendar.

cards.title: Find the Block Party
cards.subtitle: Week of Welcome tradition
cards.notes: Check the Week of Welcome program for the current Block Party details and use it as a low-pressure first stop for campus activities.
cards.short_summary: A named welcome event included in UNF’s semester-opening series.
cards.evidence_claim: UNF lists the Welcome to College Block Party among Week of Welcome’s featured recurring events.
cards.access_notes: Offered as part of Week of Welcome; verify the current semester’s time and location.

cards.title: Wear Blue for Blue Years
cards.subtitle: Week of Welcome event
cards.notes: Look for Blue Years in the Week of Welcome lineup and follow the event’s current participation guidance from Student Life.
cards.short_summary: A named Osprey-pride event within UNF’s welcome-week programming.
cards.evidence_claim: UNF lists Blue Years as one of the featured events in its Week of Welcome series.
cards.access_notes: The event is part of Week of Welcome; current details are published by Student Life.

cards.title: Turn Out for a Pep Rally
cards.subtitle: Week of Welcome school-spirit event
cards.notes: Attend a listed pep rally to experience a structured school-spirit event; follow staff directions and event-specific accessibility guidance on site.
cards.short_summary: Pep rallies are a named component of UNF’s recurring welcome programming.
cards.evidence_claim: UNF includes Pep Rallies among the featured events in its Week of Welcome series.
cards.access_notes: Schedules vary by semester; consult the current Week of Welcome calendar.

cards.title: Catch OzFest
cards.subtitle: Annual UNF spring concert
cards.notes: Watch Student Life announcements for the spring concert lineup and entry guidance; the Battle of the Bands winner opens before headlining performers.
cards.short_summary: UNF’s annual spring concert, featuring a Battle of the Bands opening act.
cards.evidence_claim: UNF describes OzFest as its highly anticipated annual spring concert and says the Battle of the Bands winner opens for the headliners.
cards.access_notes: Spring date, performers, and admission details change annually; verify with Student Life.

cards.title: Try UNF Oktoberfest
cards.subtitle: Campus tradition since 1972
cards.notes: Check Student Life’s current program for the event’s performances and treats, including the university-listed root beer and butterbeer options.
cards.short_summary: A UNF-specific Oktoberfest tradition dating to 1972.
cards.evidence_claim: UNF states that Oktoberfest has been a cherished UNF tradition since 1972 and lists root beer, butterbeer, performances, and treats.
cards.access_notes: Verify the current event date and offerings through Student Life.

cards.title: Exit to “Free Bird”
cards.subtitle: UNF commencement closing tradition
cards.notes: At commencement’s conclusion, remain seated until the platform party and faculty leave, then follow your college marshal toward the exit.
cards.short_summary: UNF graduates leave commencement as “Free Bird” plays.
cards.evidence_claim: UNF’s ceremony instructions direct graduates to exit with their college marshal as Lynyrd Skynyrd’s “Free Bird” plays.
cards.access_notes: Applies to participating graduates at commencement; follow the current ceremony instructions and marshal directions.
